cohort: 262 children who were HLA-DQ2 positive at birth
finding: The prevalence of celiac disease in this cohort of HLA-DQ2 positive children was 4%, with half of them having digestive symptoms, and a high proportion showing spontaneous disappearance of antibodies over time.
mod_finding: Female sex was a risk factor for celiac disease, whereas breastfeeding during gluten introduction had a protective effect.
